title: Step 2 - Selecting the Best Regression Model: Random Forest vs. SVR Performance

cues.en: Instructor: But according to you, is it going to be the best model?
cues.zh: 但你覺得這會是最佳模型嗎？

cues.en: Well, that's what we're going to figure out very quickly because then we're going to run all the cells here for the polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 很快就能知道，現在執行多項式迴歸的全部儲存格。

cues.en: There we go, as you can see, it's going very fast, and well for the polynomial regression model with, remember a degree of 4, we get a final R squared coefficient of 0.9458.
cues.zh: 很快就完成。記得次數是 4，最終 R² 為 0.9458。

cues.en: So we already beat our multiple linear regression model, and therefore so far the best one is polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 已經超越多元線性迴歸，所以目前最好的是多項式迴歸。

cues.en: Feel free to actually test some other degrees if you want.
cues.zh: 你也可以試其他次數。

cues.en: But now we're gonna move on to support vector regression and see if it's going to beat the polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 現在看支援向量迴歸，能否超越多項式迴歸。

cues.en: I actually really like this model and usually I get the best results with this.
cues.zh: 我很喜歡這個模型，通常結果最好。

cues.en: But let's see, let's run all the cells and in a flashlight we'll get the final performance.
cues.zh: 執行全部儲存格，馬上就會得到效能結果。

cues.en: No, not yet, not yet, actually.
cues.zh: 還沒，稍等。

cues.en: And by very, very short, it beats indeed the polynomial regression model, 0.9480, and here we had actually 09458.
cues.zh: 非常些微地超越了多項式，R² 為 0.9480，而前面是 0.9458。

cues.en: So far, the best model is the support vector regression.
cues.zh: 目前最佳是支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: Can you see how we're going super fast here, right?
cues.zh: 看得出來速度很快嗎？

cues.en: We only had to change the name of the dataset here and all the rest is automatic, and that's the beauty of code templates.
cues.zh: 只改資料集名稱，其他全部自動完成，這就是模板的優點。

cues.en: Now, let's move on to the next one, decision tree regression, and let's see if it can beat the support vector regression which remember has 0.948.
cues.zh: 接著看決策樹，能否超越 R²=0.948 的支援向量迴歸。

cues.en: So let's see, let's run, all the cells, and the final result is 0.922.
cues.zh: 執行所有儲存格，結果是 0.922。

cues.en: Okay, so that's actually the worst.
cues.zh: 這反而是最差的。

cues.en: I think it is indeed worse than the multiple linear regression, yes.
cues.zh: 甚至比多元線性迴歸還差，沒錯。

cues.en: So the decision tree regression model did not perform well here, but maybe that's because it didn't have enough team spirit to tackle these predictions, and that's what we're gonna figure out
cues.zh: 決策樹在這裡表現不佳，也許缺乏團隊精神；接下來透過隨機森林

cues.en: with random forest regression, because indeed a random forest regression model is a bunch of trees stemming up to return and ultimate prediction.
cues.zh: 來確認，因為森林是多棵樹合作，給出最終預測。

cues.en: So, now the ultimate question is, do you think that the final winner of this competition is going to be the support vector regression model
cues.zh: 最後的問題是，這場比賽的贏家會是支援向量迴歸，

cues.en: or the running forest regression model?
cues.zh: 還是隨機森林？

cues.en: Take your bet, and let's see if you're right.
cues.zh: 猜猜看，看看是否猜中。

cues.en: So there we go, we're about to find out in a second because we're gonna click Run all now and we're gonna get the final, final result with a final R squared coefficient of actually 0.96,
cues.zh: 現在按 Run All，馬上取得最後結果，R² 是 0.96，

cues.en: which therefore makes the random forest regression the big winner of this data competition.
cues.zh: 因此隨機森林是這場資料競賽的大贏家。

cues.en: So congratulations, in a very few seconds, you were able to quickly identify and select the best regression model.
cues.zh: 恭喜，短短幾秒就能找出並選擇最佳迴歸模型。

cues.en: And mostly, the most important thing in all this is to finally know how to answer this.
cues.zh: 最重要的是，終於知道如何回答這個

cues.en: Very often asked question, how do I select the best model?
cues.zh: 常見問題：要如何選最佳模型？

cues.en: And well, the answer is, you simply try all of them, and using the R squared coefficient, you compare them and conclude on which one is the best.
cues.zh: 答案是全部試試，再用 R² 比較，判斷哪個最好。

cues.en: And in our situation here for this dataset, well the best is the random forest regression.
cues.zh: 對這份資料而言，最好的是隨機森林。

cues.en: All right, so congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: Now you know a lot, you have an expertise in regression models.
cues.zh: 你已具備許多迴歸模型知識。

cues.en: You not only know how to build them but also you have all these code templates which you can use very efficiently to select the best machine learning model for your regression problem,
cues.zh: 不只知道如何建立，也有模板能有效率地選出迴歸問題的最佳機器學習模型，

cues.en: and that for any dataset.
cues.zh: 適用任何資料集。

cues.en: And remember, if your dataset has missing data or categorical data, well you only have to grab your tools in the data preprocessing toolkit to handle these situations,
cues.zh: 記得若有缺失值或類別資料，先用前處理工具箱處理，

cues.en: and then you can deploy your code templates.
cues.zh: 再套用模板。

cues.en: All right, so I'm super excited, and super happy now that we completed 100% this part two on regression.
cues.zh: 很高興，我們已完整完成第二部分迴歸。

cues.en: And now my friends, we're gonna move on to a brand new branch of machine learning which is classification, and which we're gonna do exactly the same, but this time to predict a category.
cues.zh: 接著進入全新的分支：分類。做法類似，但這次預測類別。

cues.en: And same as what we did for this regression branch, well, we will build several classification models and at the end I'll show you again how to select the best one.
cues.zh: 一樣會建立數個模型，最後再示範如何選最佳模型。

cues.en: So I can't wait to see you in this part three.
cues.zh: 期待在第三部分見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
